images.filename: Interior of National Arboretum Chapel - geograph.org.uk - 403673.jpg
images.caption: Interior of National Arboretum Chapel The daily homage. The Chapel is the only place within the UK where a silence is observed on every day of the year. It takes place at 11 o'clock and a light shines on the altar from the bearing and elevation of the sun at 11.00 am on the day of the 11th November, Armistice Day.
images.alt: Interior of National Arboretum Chapel The daily homage. The Chapel is the only place within the UK where a silence is observed on every day of the year. It takes place at 11 o'clock and a light shines on the altar from the bearing and elevation of the sun at 11.00 am on the day of the 11th November, Armistice Day.
categories: Images from Geograph Britain and Ireland
